notes: Evals for the PRD-generation phase. Each prompt isolates one routing or shape decision (brainstorming-context inheritance, idempotency, missing-arg stop, locale handling, FR/AC ID regex compliance). Subagents respond by describing what they'd do plus the literal payload they would emit; expensive end-to-end runs against a live workflow.json are reserved for the dogfood RETRO loop, not these scoped evals.

evals.name: inherits-brainstorming-context
evals.prompt: You're invoked with `feat dir: docs/browzer/feat-20260505-eval-brainstorm-inherit/`. The workflow.json already contains a COMPLETED `STEP_01_BRAINSTORMING` step with a fully populated `brainstorming.convergentModel`, `resolvedDimensions[]`, and `assumptions[]`. Describe in 4 sentences how you would consume the brainstorming output BEFORE writing the PRD, and which fields you'd cite.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads STEP_01_BRAINSTORMING via `browzer workflow get-step`, treats it as authoritative input, and threads `brainstorming.convergentModel` plus `resolvedDimensions[]` into the PRD's overview/personas/objectives. NEVER asks clarifying questions when the brainstorming step exists with COMPLETED status.

evals.name: idempotent-when-prd-exists
evals.prompt: You're invoked with `feat dir: docs/browzer/feat-20260505-eval-prd-exists/`. workflow.json already has a COMPLETED `STEP_02_PRD` step. What do you do? Show the exact one-line confirmation message you would emit.
evals.expected_output: Idempotent — does NOT regenerate the PRD. Emits a one-line confirmation referencing the existing STEP_02_PRD and the inherited PRD title/SHA, then exits cleanly. The skill body's idempotency rule prevents stomping on an already-approved PRD.

evals.name: stops-when-feat-dir-missing
evals.prompt: You're invoked with NO `feat dir:` arg, NO recent feat-* directory, and the operator's prompt was just 'write a PRD'. Show the literal one-line stop message + hint you would emit.
evals.expected_output: Skill stops cleanly with a one-line `generate-prd: stopped at <stage> — <cause>` followed by a `hint:` pointing at the orchestrator (`Skill(orchestrate-task-delivery, ...)`) or asking for an explicit feat dir. No PRD generation attempt without a destination.

evals.name: fr-ac-id-regex-compliance
evals.prompt: Generate a 3-FR / 4-AC PRD shell (no full body needed) for a feature called 'webhook delivery'. ONLY show the `functionalRequirements[]` and `acceptanceCriteria[]` arrays in JSONC. Make sure each id matches the schema.
evals.expected_output: Each FR id matches `^FR-[0-9]+$` (`FR-1`, `FR-2`, `FR-3` — sequential, no slug suffix). Each AC id matches `^AC-[0-9]+$` (`AC-1`...`AC-4`). The CUE validator rejects slug suffixes (`FR-1-webhooks`) and gaps in numbering would surface during the bindsTo cross-validator in generate-task.
